questionTreeSource.title: Ulcerative-colitis public Reddit demand: validated 39-node question tree
questionTreeSource.note: Reddit question tree is evidence of PATIENT DEMAND ONLY. Reddit posts and personal experiences are not medical evidence and were not used as evidence sources.

topicsSelectedThisRun.title: UC disease-activity monitoring biomarkers (fecal calprotectin, CRP, ESR)
topicsSelectedThisRun.rationale: Highest concentration of 'none' coverage nodes in the demand tree sits under L2-1.2 monitoring; biomarker interpretation is a top Reddit demand (L1-1, priority 10) and is guideline-dense, so high-quality evidence can be found quickly.

topicsSelectedThisRun.title: Treat-to-target and remission definitions (clinical vs endoscopic vs histologic; mucosal healing)
topicsSelectedThisRun.rationale: L3-1.2.3 ('difference between symptom control and clinical/endoscopic/deeper remission') has 'none' coverage and a single authoritative consensus (STRIDE-II) answers it directly.

topicsDeferred.title: Acute severe UC: red-flag symptoms and urgent/emergency assessment
topicsDeferred.reason: High clinical risk and 'none' coverage, but needs full-text guideline sections (Truelove-Witts criteria) that could not be safely retrieved within the run's time and query budget.

topicsDeferred.title: Starting a UC medicine; side-effect/infection monitoring; assessing loss of response (incl. therapeutic drug monitoring)
topicsDeferred.reason: Large topic; out of scope for a 2-topic increment.

topicsDeferred.title: Biologics / small molecules / JAK inhibitors: comparative positioning and colectomy decisions
topicsDeferred.reason: Partly pre-staged (SRC-031/032 planned); needs reconciliation with prior planned run.

topicsDeferred.title: Pregnancy, extraintestinal manifestations, and colorectal-cancer surveillance
Diet during active disease and remission (UC-specific)
topicsDeferred.reason: Prior IBD package already has partial diet coverage; lower marginal value this run.

coverageByNode.normalizedQuestion: How should I understand monitoring results and whether I am in remission?
coverageByNode.priorLikelyGap: No UC-eligible biomarker, colonoscopy, mucosal-healing, or ultrasound claims.
coverageByNode.residualGapAfterRun: Monitoring intervals, intestinal-ultrasound role, and UC-specific ESR value remain uncovered.

coverageByNode.normalizedQuestion: What do fecal calprotectin, CRP, ESR, and other tests contribute to monitoring?
coverageByNode.priorLikelyGap: Fecal calprotectin and CRP claims are Crohn’s-only; ESR is absent.
coverageByNode.residualGapAfterRun: Fecal calprotectin / CRP covered by candidate claims; ESR has no UC-specific candidate claim; no diagnostic-accuracy meta-analysis ingested yet.

coverageByNode.normalizedQuestion: Why might colonoscopy, biopsy, or imaging be recommended when symptoms or labs look reassuring?
coverageByNode.priorLikelyGap: No UC-eligible evidence for colonoscopy, mucosal healing, or intestinal ultrasound.
coverageByNode.residualGapAfterRun: Colonoscopy/biopsy rationale only partially covered (discordance + mild-symptom scenarios); dedicated biopsy/surveillance evidence still needed.

coverageByNode.normalizedQuestion: What is the difference between symptom control and clinical, endoscopic, or deeper remission?
coverageByNode.priorLikelyGap: The package lacks UC-specific treat-to-target and mucosal-healing claims.
coverageByNode.residualGapAfterRun: Clinical vs endoscopic vs histologic remission defined via candidate claims; mucosal-healing prognosis evidence still needed.

coverageByNode.normalizedQuestion: How can I recognize a possible flare and judge how urgently I need help?
coverageByNode.priorLikelyGap: No UC-specific evidence pathway integrates symptoms, alternative causes, and escalation thresholds.
coverageByNode.residualGapAfterRun: Only the concordant moderate/severe biomarker scenario touched; acute-severe-UC red flags (L3-1.1.2) not yet addressed.

coverageByNode.normalizedQuestion: What can I do when treatment, specialist appointments, tests, or medicines are delayed or unaffordable?
coverageByNode.priorLikelyGap: No access, insurance, formulary, or affordability evidence is included.
coverageByNode.residualGapAfterRun: Only the STRIDE-II 'adapt to local resources' caveat; access/affordability evidence otherwise uncovered.
